blocker.reason: Individual-level inputs are not public: the paper deposits kidney RNA-seq/ATAC/single-nucleus data only at CMDGA (cmdga.org, searchTerm=FNIH0000000); anonymous API queries return 142 released experiment records but every one has files=[] (e.g. DSR060OQF snATAC-seq: original_files=[], files=[]), i.e. file access requires AMP consortium sign-in. RASQUAL/snASA need matched WGS genotypes of the 613/522/82 kidney donors (protected human genomic data, not deposited). CARMA meta fine-mapping needs per-cohort sumstats from MVP/TWB/All of Us/UKB (controlled). Only derived tables are public (Figshare 26299093), which the other analyses use.

analyses.title: Re-derive ASE / bASA / snASA / Open4Gene / CARMA fine-mapping from individual-level data

claim.quote: RASQUAL on 613 tubule / 522 glomeruli / 82 ATAC kidneys; snASA on 237,274 cells; Open4Gene on 62,278 multiome cells; CARMA fine-mapping of the per-cohort meta-analysis

blocker.reason: Not reproduced. The main text gives only 'conditional analysis on the top variant' with GCTA-COJO 1.93; the exact procedure (which variant is conditioned on which, LD panel, significance rule) is in the supplementary Methods PDF, and the per-gene result (table S28) is in the Tables S1-S31 zip. Neither is on Figshare. Confirmed 2026-09-26: the exact files are at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/12013656/bin/NIHMS2065775-supplement-Supplemental_Material.pdf and .../NIHMS2065775-supplement-Tables_S1_to_S31.zip (found via curl on the article page's own hrefs), but fetching either returns HTTP 200 with a 'Preparing to download ...' page running a client-side proof-of-work challenge (window.ncbi.pmc.pow.init, cookie cloudpmc-viewer-pow) before the real file is served — a deliberate anti-bot gate, not a dead link. Solving it programmatically would be automated evasion of that gate, so this port does not attempt it. Not an access restriction otherwise: a human opening either URL in a real browser gets the file (the PoW resolves client-side), and can drop it under Data/liu2025/ for this port to pick up.

analyses.title: 161 genes with converged coding and regulatory variants after GCTA-COJO conditional analysis

claim.quote: For each of these genes, we performed conditional analysis on the top variant, resulting in 161 genes with the convergence of coding and regulatory variants
